title: Shillo
tagline: AI Token Launchpad – 24/7 shilling, real-time updates, and effortless community growth.
description:
The Problem Shillo Solves
Launching and promoting a token is exhausting, expensive, and time-consuming. Memecoin creators face several challenges, including:

- Manually building and managing communities
- Costly marketing agencies with slow results
- The need to constantly post on social media to stay relevant
- Struggling to stand out in an oversaturated market
- Keeping communities engaged without burning out

💡 Enter Shillo – The AI-Powered Token Launchpad on Celo
Shillo eliminates the manual grind by automating token promotion through AI-powered personalities that engage, entertain, and grow your community 24/7.

Our AI-powered Token Launchpad is designed to drive viral social engagement and redefine how tokens are launched and promoted. Here's how Shillo aligns seamlessly with the Retard-Viral-Social track:
how_its_made:
🧩 Core Technologies
Live2D Cubism (Python Wrapper)
At the heart of Shillo is a custom Python wrapper for Live2D Cubism, allowing us to seamlessly control animated AI characters. These characters react to user input, market events, and blockchain activity in real time—bringing tokens to life in a fun and engaging way.

LangChain + AI Stack
We integrated LangChain to power contextual AI responses for social media posts, stream chats, and meme generation—giving each token a unique personality and voice.

React + NestJS + Socket.IO

React drives the frontend with a dynamic UI for users to interact with their AI agents.

NestJS powers the backend with REST and WebSocket APIs.

Socket.IO enables real-time communication between the AI engine, blockchain events, and frontend interfaces.

Dockerized AI Engine
We wrapped the Live2D + AI personality engine into a Docker container, making deployment a breeze. With a single click, projects can spin up their own AI shiller—no complex setup required.

Blockchain + Smart Contracts
Our custom Launchpad Smart Contract (deployed on Celo) handles token launches. It emits events like liquidity adds or trades, which our AI listens to and reacts to instantly.
